title: Schedule-only edits do not request a new key-value backup
status: open - code confirmed; OS timing not established
reproduction: Inspect named and URL schedule writers and the application for a BackupManager change notification after an edit.
expected: Ask the OS to include a changed user configuration in a future backup without promising a particular backup time.
observed: The preference stores are now registered but there is no app-side dataChanged notification. Explicit backupnow bypasses this question.
fix: Open: validate the dirty notification independently from the exercised forced restore. Exclude last-run bookkeeping from the eligibility signal.
test_evidence: Source inspection and Android BackupManager contract; timing on a user phone not tested. See deep-signoff/platform-restore.md.
